profile.headline: Software Engineer, Comcast
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Comcast using technical data to optimize software development, user experience, and other activities within our business services division.

Cofounder and former Chief Operating Officer at Allelo. Allelo is empowering classrooms with a platform for constructive conversation while connecting students across the world.

Previously E-Commerce Analyst at Dinosaurs Rock involved in online retail efforts and educational program development. I aided in the production of VR films & games at New Reality Company, designed chatbots at the USC Institute for Creative Technologies, ran Baruch College online literary magazine RefractMag as Editor in Chief, and founded a community of gamers at CUNY Games Society. Graduated from Macaulay Honors College with a dual-major Bachelor of Arts magna cum laude in Cognitive Science & Computers and Interactive Storytelling.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Specialize in Tableau, developing data visualizations to empower business partners with key insights into their data.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Large Language Models (LLM) · Data Science · Teamwork · Data Analysis · Natural Language Processing · Tableau · Generative AI · Prompt Engineering · Chatbots · Pandas · Conversation Design · Python · Conversational Agents · NLTK

positions.title: Cofounder, Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
- Directed operations and managed a data scientist while overseeing feature development for a chat-based platform designed to foster constructive conversations and connect students globally.
- Led development of an engagement metrics dashboard for analyzing student conversational data and an AI-driven phrasing suggestion feature using GPT-2 to improve dialogue quality.
- Collaborated with stakeholders across engineering, design, and business to refine platform functionality and user experience through iterative testing and feedback loops.
- Secured six figure seed funding through investor outreach and pitch development; built financial projections, managed payroll, and facilitated strategic planning for growth.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Data Science · Teamwork · Natural Language Processing

positions.title: E-Commerce Analyst
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Led e-commerce initiatives across Amazon, Walmart, and eBay, optimizing product listings for SEO through strategic keyword usage, naming conventions, and enhanced descriptions and images.
- Compiled and analyzed Amazon Brand Analytics, Business Reports, and Inventory Reports to identify trends, adjust campaigns, and maximize ROI.
- Designed and launched the Amazon Brand Store, improving brand discoverability and user experience.
- Supported educational outreach by conducting interactive shows and exhibits on fossils, minerals, and natural sciences.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Teamwork · Data Analysis

positions.title: Studio Manager
positions.description:
- Managed festival production for award-winning virtual reality experiences Tree and Giant, including training docents, calibrating multi-sensory VR installations, and guiding participants through immersive experiences.
- Playtested VR builds and provided actionable feedback to developers, sound designers, and experiential designers to improve quality and user experience.
- Maintained and troubleshot VR-ready workstation hardware and software, ensuring smooth operation during events.
- Wrote and edited copy for fundraising pitch decks, newsletters, and internal technical guides, supporting business development and investor engagement.

positions.title: Studio Intern
positions.description: Skills: Teamwork · Interactive Storytelling · Public Speaking · Virtual Reality (VR) · Digital Storytelling

positions.title: Editor in Chief
positions.description:
- Managed a 15-member editorial team for an online literary and arts magazine, overseeing content strategy, editing, and publication workflows.
- Directed the website redesign and coordinated the publication of 10+ pieces, including interactive stories and multimedia content.
- Led writing, copy editing, and content editing workshops for staff and facilitated college-wide sessions to improve writing quality and editorial standards.

positions.title: Managing Editor
positions.description: Skills: Teamwork · Creative Writing · Writing · Editing

positions.title: Founder & Co-President
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Founded and led the CUNY Games Society, creating a university-wide gaming community focused on game-based learning and interactive media.
- Organized and facilitated game nights and themed events, leveraging knowledge of gaming and market trends to design engaging itineraries.
- Developed and executed a long-term growth strategy for the organization through continuous community engagement and outreach.
- Managed board meetings and coordinated logistics for events to ensure smooth operations and strong member participation.

positions.title: Research Assistant Intern
positions.description:
- Programmed dialogue policies and conversational behaviors for a chatbot using the FLoReS dialogue manager and a custom scripting language to enable natural, story-driven interactions.
- Collected and curated utterance data for the New Dimensions in Testimony project, supporting virtual conversational experiences with Holocaust survivors.
- Developed a topic ontology to define entities and relationships for use in virtual agents, improving semantic understanding and dialogue flow.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Teamwork · Interactive Storytelling · Virtual Reality (VR) · Research · Digital Storytelling · Chatbots · Conversational Agents

positions.title: REU Student Researcher - Biomimetic and Cognitive Robotics Laboratory
positions.description:
- Designed and programmed a biomimetic artificial neural network in C++ modeled on pincer function in leaf-cutter ants, for implementation in a hexapod robot to support research in adaptive locomotion and cognitive robotics.
- Awarded a National Science Foundation Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) in Psychology & Neuroscience for contributions to neural modeling and robotics research.

company.name: New Media Artspace at Baruch College

positions.title: Docent
positions.description:
- Organized and conducted successful tour and lesson for 140 incoming first-year students.
- Updated website and social media with exhibit/artist information.
- Documented and archived exhibits.

positions.title: Tutor of Philosophy/Predicate Logic
positions.description: - Aided students to develop and master skills in logical reasoning, supported their academic growth.

positions.title: Writer
positions.description:
- Developed story for Forgotten Star IP – faction attitudes and relationships, quest design, naming schemes.
- Wrote Forgotten-Star.com content and marketing materials.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Creative Writing · Writing · Editing · Digital Storytelling

projects.title: Chatbots: An Interactive Storytelling Revolution
projects.description: Undergraduate capstone research project presented at the National Conference for Undergraduate Research 2017. Encompasses discussion on the role of chatbots in videogames and how chatbot technology can enhance storytelling in virtual reality.

organizations.name: CUNY Games Society
organizations.description:
- Created organization; mission: develop a CUNY-wide gaming community.
- Formulated long-term strategy for future club growth and activities.
- Organized numerous game night club events.
